selection_rationale: Official multilingual sentence- and document-level semantic graph annotations, a stable public release, and explicit per-graphbank terms. This is the closest verified graph-supervision resource found for the proposal.
known_limits: Per-graphbank terms differ; several graphbanks are non-commercial and prohibit derivatives. No graphbank is approved for XAI model training by this repository manifest until rights for that use and the planned model artifacts are confirmed.
The published 2.0 release has one annotated graph per sentence, not a set of materially acceptable alternate readings.
The release has about 3.1 million tokens in total and is too small by itself for the proposed multilingual denoising-pretraining schedule.

The official data repository distinguishes manually annotated non-partial-conversion data from partial conversions. Partial conversions must be excluded from the graph-supervision target unless separately audited and explicitly approved.
UMR is not the XAI candidate-graph schema. A reviewed mapping and exact original-text byte-span alignment are required; token-index alignments must not be silently treated as UTF-8 byte spans.
